{"id":"JMAP-tna1.3.13","title":"tasks-server history: Task, TaskList","description":"Design: docs/design/object-history.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: H13. Crates: jmap-tasks-types, jmap-tasks-server, jmap-chat-tasks-server (README only). Size: M.

Scope per decision 5. Spec: object-history-03 §3, §4, §5.1, §7.4 (objectHistory reserved for JSCalendar Task); draft-ietf-jmap-tasks-06 §3.4 (onDestroyRemoveTasks). Design: docs/design/object-history.md §2 (7.2 row), §4 (PENDING_HISTORY_REGISTRATION), §5, §9 'Decision-5 crates' tasks bullet; follow H4's shape.

Task/TaskList are implemented ahead of registration. The Tasks draft has no JMAP Data Types entries, so they rely on OHT's pending list.

Work:
- impl HistoryObject for Task and TaskList, NOT TaskNotification (a proposed exclusion, D1).
- _set_impl split; history handlers. Task has /query; TaskList has none.
- register_tasks_handlers_with_history.
- Task/copy is an id-minting path and must not reuse logged ids.
- Memory: record onDestroyRemoveTasks cascades; a refused TaskList destroy records nothing; rights_changed_at per TaskList.
- History entries apply the same per-caller hidden-property projection the chat-tasks bridge uses (task_hidden_properties); note this in the chat-tasks-server README.
- Registry cross-check test (Task/TaskList pass via the pending list).

Acceptance:
- Restored Task in /changes is updated or created.
- Task/copy never mints a logged id.
- Cascade destroys appear in includeDestroyed.
- objectHistory in a Task create ⇒ invalidProperties.
- A TaskNotification history flag ⇒ invalidArguments.
